rules: Discovered competing branch revokes current trust
Invalidate downstream consumers pinned to revoked checkpoint
Mirror witnesses do not add independent roots
Unresolved competing branch cannot itself become replacement
Never silently migrate stale consumers to new checkpoint
limits: Proof object is synthetic and not cryptographically authenticated
Witness roots are declared and not independently verified
Notification is an append-only queue record, not delivered to real consumers
State and hash-chain log are in-memory rather than durable transactional storage
Replacing forked ancestry is permitted here only as a toy governance transition, not a full consensus protocol
